ruleDefinitions.name: Schtasks Creation Or Modification With SYSTEM Privileges
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation or update of a scheduled task to run with "NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM" privileges

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/change\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/create\\ .*"))) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/ru\\ .*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*NT\\ AUT.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ SYSTEM\\ .*"))) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/TN\\ TVInstallRestore.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\TeamViewer\\_\\\.exe.*"))) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*Subscription\\ Heartbeat.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\HeartbeatConfig\\\.xml.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\ Shared\\\\OFFICE.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/Create\\ \\/F\\ \\/RU\\ System\\ \\/SC\\ WEEKLY\\ \\/TN\\ AviraSystemSpeedupVerify\\ \\/TR\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Avira\\\\System\\ Speedup\\\\setup\\\\avira\\_speedup\\_setup\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/VERIFY\\ \\/VERYSILENT\\ \\/NOSTART\\ \\/NODOTNET\\ \\/NORESTART\\"\\ \\/RL\\ HIGHEST.*")))
